en: End Tutorial
zh: 结束教程

en: You're ready to proceed.
zh: 你已经准备好了。

en: Skip Tutorial
zh: 跳过教程

en: Are you sure to skip the tutorial?
zh: 确定要跳过教程吗？

en: Welcome to the Tutorial.
zh: 欢迎来到教程。

en: It's time to get prepared in the city for the upcoming adventure.
zh: 为了应对即将到来的冒险，\n 现在开始在城里进行准备吧。

en: Click on your character to start moving.
zh: 点击角色开始移动。

en: Move your mouse along the tiles to plan a path,\nthen click the destination to confirm.
zh: 沿着格子移动鼠标来规划路径，在终点点击进行确认。

en: Each move takes [color=#BC3D37]3 hours[/color]. Keep that in mind.
zh: 每次移动会消耗[color=#BC3D37]3小时[/color]，还请留意。

en: Try stopping on that strange tile over there.
zh: 试着移动到那个奇怪的格子上吧。

en: You got [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/apple.png[/img][font_size=40]Apple x 1[/font_size]!\nNot sure what it's for yet...
zh: 获得了[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/apple.png[/img][font_size=40]苹果 x 1[/font_size]。\n虽然不知道能用来做什么…

en: Seems like someone's posting a quest.\nGo pay them a visit.
zh: 似乎有人正在发布任务。\n去拜访看看吧。

en: “I need [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/apple.png[/img][font_size=40]Apple x 1[/font_size] and [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/grape.png[/img][font_size=40]Grapes x 1[/font_size], please!”
zh: “我需要[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/apple.png[/img][font_size=40]苹果 x 1[/font_size] 和[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/grape.png[/img][font_size=40]葡萄 x 1[/font_size]，拜托了！”

en: Just [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/grape.png[/img][font_size=40]Grapes x 1[/font_size] left to complete the quest.
zh: 还差[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/grape.png[/img][font_size=40]葡萄 x 1[/font_size] 就能完成任务。

en: That tile ahead might have some.\nGive it a try.
zh: 前面的格子或许可以抽到。\n试试看吧。

en: Got the fruit you needed!\nNow head back to deliver it.
zh: 抽到了需要的水果。\n现在回去提交吧。

en: Unlike [img={"height":"35"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/quest_new.png[/img] [font_size=40]Accepting Quests[/font_size],\n[img={"height":"35"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/quest_complete.png[/img] [font_size=40]Completing Quests[/font_size] doesn't require stopping on the tile.\nPassing through will automatically deliver them.
zh: 不同于 [img={"height":"35"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/quest_new.png[/img] [font_size=40]接受任务[/font_size]，\n [img={"height":"35"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/quest_complete.png[/img] [font_size=40]完成任务 [/font_size]时不需要停留在格子上，路过就会自动交付。

en: “Thanks for the fruit! Here are [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/exchange coupon italic.png[/img] [font_size=40]Exchange Coupons x 2[/font_size].\nYou can use them at the shop.”
zh: “感谢你的水果！送你 [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/exchange coupon italic.png[/img] [font_size=40]交换券 x 2[/font_size]，可以用来在商店购物哦。”

en: Another [font_size=40]Quest[/font_size]? Go pay them a visit.
zh: 另一位似乎也有[font_size=40] 任务[/font_size]？拜访看看吧。

en: “Could you deliver a message to the Giraffe for me? Please!”
zh: "可以麻烦帮我传个信给长颈鹿吗？拜托了！”

en: Sometimes you'll also receive [img={"height":"40"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/quest_fruit.png[/img] [font_size=40]Message Delivery Quests[/font_size],\nnot just [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/quest_delivery.png[/img] [font_size=40]Fruit Quests[/font_size].
zh: 除了 [img={"height":"40"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/quest_fruit.png[/img] [font_size=40]水果任务[/font_size]，有时也会接到 [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/quest_delivery.png[/img] [font_size=40]传信任务[/font_size]。

en: “Thanks for the message! Here's [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/exchange coupon italic.png[/img] [font_size=40]Exchange Coupon x 1[/font_size].\nCheck out the nearby shop when you can.”
zh: “感谢！给你 [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/exchange coupon italic.png[/img] [font_size=40]交换券 x 1[/font_size]，有空的话去附近的商店看看吧。”

en: [img={"height":"45"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/trade_shop.png[/img] [font_size=40]The shop[/font_size] is open!\nYou can buy things with [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/exchange coupon italic.png[/img] [font_size=40]Exchange Coupons[/font_size].\nTake a look.
zh: [img={"height":"45"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/trade_shop.png[/img] [font_size=40]商店[/font_size] 开张，可以用 [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/exchange coupon italic.png[/img] [font_size=40]交换券 [/font_size]购物了。\n进去看看吧。

en: Other items are a bit pricey.\nHow about trying a [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/mystery_box.png[/img][font_size=40]Mystery Box[/font_size] instead?
zh: 其他商品有点贵。\n不如先买个[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/mystery_box.png[/img][font_size=40]盲盒[/font_size] 碰碰运气？

en: You got [font_size=40]Fruit of Your Choice x 2[/font_size]!\nClick the glowing fruit icons to pick the ones you want.
zh: 获得了[font_size=40] 自选水果 x 2[/font_size]。\n点击闪烁的水果图标，挑选想要的吧。

en: At the [img={"height":"45"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Grid/1x/shop_upgrade.png[/img] [font_size=40]Upgrade Tile[/font_size],\nyou can use [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/trade upgrade coupon.png[/img][font_size=40]Upgrade Coupons[/font_size] to purchase various [font_size=40]Upgrades[/font_size].
zh: 在 [img={"height":"45"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Grid/1x/shop_upgrade.png[/img][font_size=40] 升级格 [/font_size]可以用[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/trade upgrade coupon.png[/img][font_size=40]升级券 [/font_size]购买各种[font_size=40] 升级[/font_size]。

en: You don't have any [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/trade upgrade coupon.png[/img][font_size=40]Upgrade Coupons[/font_size] yet.\nGather some [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/exchange coupon italic.png[/img] [font_size=40]Exchange Coupons[/font_size] first,\nthen visit the shop to buy one.
zh: 现在还没有[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/trade upgrade coupon.png[/img][font_size=40]升级券 [/font_size]呢。\n先努力获取 [img={"height":"50"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/exchange coupon italic.png[/img] [font_size=40]交换券[/font_size]，再去商店购买吧。

en: Aside from the unlimited [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/mystery_box.png[/img][font_size=40]Mystery Boxes[/font_size],\nall other items will be temporarily out of stock after being sold.
zh: 除了无限供应的[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/mystery_box.png[/img]盲盒，其他商品出售后都会暂时缺货。

en: Every day at [color=#BC3D37]00:00[/color],\nthe shop restocks with random items and also resets your 3 manual refresh uses.
zh: 商店会在[color=#BC3D37]每天 00:00 [/color]上架随机商品，同时重置3次手动刷新次数。

en: You obtained [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/trade upgrade coupon.png[/img][font_size=40]Shop Upgrade Coupon x 1[/font_size].\nGo check the shop upgrade tile.
zh: 获得了[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/trade upgrade coupon.png[/img][font_size=40]商店升级券 x 1[/font_size]。\n去 [img={"height":"45"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Grid/1x/shop_upgrade.png[/img] 商店升级格看看吧。

en: There are currently two upgrades available.\nHow about buying [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/shop_manual_refresh.png[/img][font_size=40]Shop Manual Refresh[/font_size] first?
zh: 目前有两种升级可选。\n不如先买[img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/shop_manual_refresh.png[/img]“解锁商店刷新”？

en: Some upgrades can be purchased multiple times,\nincreasing both their level and effectiveness.
zh: 有些升级项可以反复购买，等级和效果随之提升。

en: Now, please buy [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/balance.png[/img][font_size=40][color=#94b757]Balance[/color] x 1[/font_size] from the shop.
zh: 现在请再次前往商店购买 [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/balance.png[/img][font_size=40][color=#94b757] 天平 [/color] x 1 [/font_size]吧。

en: [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/balance.png[/img][font_size=40][color=#94b757]Balance[/color][/font_size] provides [font_size=40]3 Shop Pts[/font_size].
zh: [img={"height":"60"}]res://Assets/Sprites/Icon/1x/balance.png[/img] [font_size=40][color=#94b757]天平[/color][/font_size] 可以提供[font_size=40] 3 商店点数[/font_size]。

en: Raising different types of points increases adventure success rate.\nBut only when all four types work together will the effect be significant.
zh: 提升各类点数可以增加冒险成功率。\n不过需要四种点数共同作用，效果才会显著哦。

en: The four types of items are sold at their respective shops.\nThey're not available yet, so let's give you some for demonstration.
zh: 四类点数道具会在对应的商店出售。\n目前没有商店能买到其他三类呢，先发放一些道具以作说明吧。

en: Adventure success rate increased!\nThe more items you prepare, the less likely you are to fail.
zh: 冒险成功率提升了！\n道具准备越充分，就越能够避免冒险失败的情况。

en: If you [font_size=40]fail[/font_size]... you'll return [color=#BC3D37]empty-handed[/color].
zh: 如果[font_size=40] 失败 [/font_size]的话...就[color=#BC3D37] 一无所获 [/color]了呢。

en: The game lasts [color=#BC3D37]60 days[/color] in total.
zh: 此外，游戏一共有[color=#BC3D37] 60 天[/color]的时间。

en: Spending more time stocking up in the city means less time left for adventures.\nYour [color=#BC3D37]Adventure Score[/color] will also decrease as days pass. Keep that in mind.
zh: 花费更多时间在城里囤积道具的话，可用于出城冒险的时间则会相应减少。\n能够获得的[color=#BC3D37]  冒险得分 [/color]也会随天数降低。请注意。

en: The goal is to achieve a higher [color=#BC3D37]Adventure Score[/color].\nSo, stock up efficiently and leave more time for the adventure itself!
zh: 游戏的目标是获取更高的[color=#BC3D37]  冒险得分[/color]。\n因此, 在城里囤积道具的同时，努力留出更多时间用来冒险吧。

en: When you're ready,\nhead to the city gate to end the tutorial and begin your adventure.
zh: 准备妥当的话，就前往城门结束教程，正式开始游戏吧。
